STRUCTURE: a SQL VIEW named consumo_por_conversacion, created by a new migration step 0003, anchored on the reservas table and LEFT JOINing the 'conciliacion' movement of each reserva, computing SUM(CASE WHEN estado = 'conciliada' THEN monto_reservado - COALESCE(monto, 0) ELSE 0 END) GROUP BY id_conversacion. WHY THIS AND NOT AN ACCUMULATOR TABLE: the orchestrator flagged a zero-delta trap that might force a materialized accumulator written inside the conciliar transaction. The trap is REAL but does NOT force it. conciliar_presupuesto guards its ledger INSERT with `if ajuste_aplicado != 0` (crates/hexcell-storage/src/presupuesto.rs:297) because migration 0002 declares CHECK (monto <> 0), so a reserva consumed exactly in full leaves NO movimientos row - proven by the existing test conciliacion_con_coincidencia_exacta_cierra_reserva_sin_movimiento. A movimientos-anchored aggregate would report 0 for that reserva. Anchoring on reservas instead makes the absent row self-correcting: monto_reservado - COALESCE(monto, 0) evaluates to monto_reservado, which IS the real consumption in precisely that case. The expression was checked against all five reconciliation branches and is exact in four of them. An accumulator table was therefore rejected: it would have required writing inside the conciliar transaction, which 00-spec.yaml invariant 4 and non_goal 4 forbid, to buy accuracy the derivation already has. QUERY SURFACE: RepositorioDeSesiones::consumo_por_conversacion returning Vec<ConsumoDeConversacion> ordered by id_conversacion, mirroring the existing saldo() and desviacion_de_conciliacion() read shape. The view doubles as the SQL-level surface for the future FR-10 operator report, which a Rust-only method would not have provided.

The orchestrator bundle offered option (d): that reservas.monto_reservado plus estado plus resuelta_ms might serve as the consumption source on their own. FALSIFIED by direct read: conciliar_presupuesto never stores unidades_consumidas anywhere, so reservas alone yields only the RESERVED amount, not the consumed one, and would misreport every over- and under-consumption. The correct source is reservas JOINed to the conciliacion movement, which is what this blueprint specifies. The bundle also warned that a pure VIEW may undercount; that warning is accurate ONLY for a view anchored on movimientos, and the contract forbids that anchor explicitly.

The derivation undercounts in exactly one branch: consumption exceeds the reserva AND saldo.disponible cannot absorb the whole deficit, where conciliar caps ajuste_aplicado at -disponible and returns the residue only as ResultadoDeResolucion.deficit_no_cubierto. Verified against the existing test conciliacion_con_deficit_no_cubierto_no_viola_saldo_no_negativo_y_reporta_resto (reserved 5, consumed 10, disponible 2, ajuste -2, deficit 3): the view reports 7, not 10. HEX-043 decided that residue is a verdict field and a log line and NEVER a ledger row, so it is not recoverable from persisted data by any structure that does not modify the write path. This is the SAME limitation already documented on desviacion_de_conciliacion (presupuesto.rs:416-419) and is consistent with adr-0005. It is therefore inherited, not introduced, and the contract requires it written down in Spanish in both the SQL and the method doc comment while forbidding any attempt to persist the deficit.
